basic_info.description: Exceptional opportunity in highly desirable NOPA! This bright, top-floor 3-bedroom, 1-bath flat is part of a beautiful Edwardian 3-unit building. 140 Cole Street combines historic charm with modern convenience. The home features newly refinished hardwood floors, high ceilings, classic wainscoting, a wood-burning fireplace, and historic architectural details throughout. Bathed in natural light, the spacious living and dining areas offer plenty of room for both relaxation and entertaining.   The large kitchen includes ample cabinet space and a cozy eat-in area. Just off the kitchen, a convenient porch provides extra storage perfect for those Costco runs as well as internal stair access to the garage. This residence comes with one designated parking spot, access to a shared yard, and laundry facilities. Located in the heart of San Francisco, you'll enjoy the best of NOPA at your doorstep: charming local shops, a wide range of services, restaurants, and cafes. Only steps from the Panhandle, Golden Gate Park, and USF, with easy access to public transportation. Don't miss out - this gem won't wait forever!
